name: @repo/pinned-list
description: A list where selected items pin to the top and animate out of the flow into a pinned section.

useCases: Pin important conversations, files or tasks to the top of a list
Favorites section that separates from the main list
Priority inbox where starred items float to a pinned group
compositionHints: Use with animated-list for the unpinned section's entrance animation
Pair with animated-avatar-group inside a custom renderItem
